Rory McIlroy Begins FedEx Cup Playoff Campaign in Memphis

Golfer Rory McIlroy has commenced his campaign at the FedEx St. Jude Championship in Memphis, the opening event of the PGA Tour's FedEx Cup Playoffs. McIlroy, who is aiming for his fourth FedEx Cup title, is competing alongside fellow Irishman Shane Lowry. The coverage notes McIlroy's presence at the event and mentions his challenging start to the tournament.
